title: Zero-Cost-First and Free-to-Access Policy
purpose: Keep Din Allah Encyclopedia freely accessible while avoiding required paid services for users and preferring open-source, free-tier, and self-hostable components.
userGuarantees: approved downloadable artifacts remain free when redistribution rights permit
translations and media remain free to access when legally redistributable
no advertising or paid gate is required by this policy

costReality.statement: Software can be free and self-hostable while compute, storage, bandwidth, domains, and third-party quotas may have limits or costs at scale.
costReality.policy: Never hide operational cost risk; design for zero-cost operation first and make paid infrastructure optional rather than a user requirement.
